reason.en: The official summary says Proposition 55 "Extends by twelve years the temporary personal income tax increases enacted in 2012 on earnings over $250,000, with revenues allocated to K–12 schools, California Community Colleges, and, in certain years, healthcare." A YES vote extended a rate already in place rather than adding a new tax, so this link shows no direction (owner ruling, 2026-10-03, as for Proposition 3).

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 8, 2016 General Election: Proposition 55

summary.en: Extended through 2030 the personal income tax increases on earnings over $250,000 that were enacted in 2012, with the revenue going to K–12 schools, community colleges and, in certain years, health care.

title.en: Tax Extension to Fund Education and Healthcare. Initiative Constitutional Amendment.
